{{Quote|Friend, you look like you've run all the way from South Talbus.|A Keshiri bartender, to Jelph Marrian|<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel]]''</ref>}}
'''South Talbus''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. In [[3959 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] former-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jelph Marrian]] visited a [[Unidentified bar (Kesh)|bar]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tahv]], and on his arrival, a [[Unidentified Keshiri bartender|Keshiri bartender]] commented that Marrian looked as if he had just came to the bar straight from South Talbus.
